deficiencies.description: The lecturer refers to 'adolescence and maturation', but the rewrite replaces 'adolescence' with 'differentiation'.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: because obviously during adolescence and maturation, this occurs from infancy to adulthood.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: because differentiation and maturation also occur from infancy to adulthood.

deficiencies.description: The rewrite turns the lecturer's pointing words ('here now') into a description of the slide ('In the image of the invasive tissue') that the lecturer did not provide.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: And you can see here now the cells are all of different shapes and sizes.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: In the image of the invasive tissue, the cells are of different shapes and sizes.

deficiencies.description: The lecturer says 'invading stroma', which the rewrite alters to 'invaded stroma'.

considerations.sourcePassage: most of your lineage specification and your expansive growth has happened during embryogenesis, during the time that you were born.
considerations.reason: The phrase 'during the time that you were born' was omitted as a false start or misspeaking for the period preceding birth/embryogenesis.

considerations.sourcePassage: It gives them structure and provides a signaling and basis for their adherence to this layer.
considerations.reason: The rewrite reads 'signalling basis' rather than 'signaling and basis', treating the word 'and' as a spoken stumble or false start.
